title: Characterization of valid paired words
statement: For every Boolean word $y$, validity is equivalent to both of the following: the length of its initial run of ones is even, and the next two bits are $01$; moreover, scanning aligned pairs in the suffix after those bits, starting with no previous pair, succeeds with some remaining word $w$, and $w$ is canonical (empty or ending in $1$).
